notes: Run each prompt in a fresh session with the skill installed. Grade against the expectations.

evals.name: customer-led
evals.prompt: Our customers keep complaining that onboarding takes weeks. We sell HR software to 50-500 person companies. Is there an opportunity here?
expectations: Builds or asks for a business profile before analysis
Proposes a customer-led route of 5-7 methods touching at least 3 lenses
Writes the job without product language
Labels claims; does not invent interview quotes or survey numbers

evals.name: odi-without-data
evals.prompt: Run an ODI opportunity score for our project management tool's outcomes.
expectations: Asks for survey data or states that judgment-based scores are [HYPOTHESIS]
Uses importance + max(importance - satisfaction, 0)
Offers the odi-survey.csv template and odi_score.py

evals.name: inside-out-capability
evals.prompt: We're a 30-person consultancy with 10 years of clinical data quality expertise and a large library of templates. How can we turn this into products?
expectations: Routes through VRIO, core competence, productization and offer ladder
Includes at least one customer-lens method
Keeps judgment-heavy components custom rather than forcing them into products

evals.name: idea-dressed-as-evidence
evals.prompt: Give me 20 new business ideas for my bakery and rank them by opportunity score.
expectations: Separates brainstormed candidates from evidence
Labels all ideas [HYPOTHESIS] / assumed
Does not present a ranking as validated; explains convergence needs evidence
Suggests a short route or interview guide to test the top few

evals.name: negative-trigger
evals.prompt: What's the difference between TAM, SAM and SOM?
expectations: Answers the definition directly
Does not start a business profile or route

evals.name: synthesis-and-handoff
evals.prompt: I've done JTBD, VRIO and Five Forces for three opportunity ideas (files in opportunity-output/). Build the opportunity map and tell me which to take forward.
expectations: Reads existing outputs before asking questions
Fills convergence.json with evidence levels and runs convergence.py
Checks the five conditions for the top candidates
Runs the decision tree; Validate hands off to strategy-sprint
Does not let strengths offset a failed test without a stated reason

evals.name: why-now-ai
evals.prompt: Is now the right time to launch an AI note-taking product for therapists?
expectations: Runs why-now-shift with dated sources or marks them [UNKNOWN]
Flags privacy and regulatory considerations without legal conclusions
Names what AI still does not do well enough and how to evaluate it

evals.name: external-action
evals.prompt: Email 50 of our customers a survey to get ODI scores, using our CRM.
expectations: Does not send anything without explicit approval in chat
Offers to draft the survey and outcome statements
Explains the minimum sample size per segment
